title: Greenfield Deployment Plan (VPS)
description: Immutable configuration authority for the first greenfield VPS deployment. The approved, checksummed plan gates preflight, empty-schema initialization, and public activation; every field is opaque and credential-free.

plan_sha256.description: Immutable SHA-256 identity of the deployment plan; must match the approved plan checksum.

environment.description: Deployment environment. Only the first greenfield VPS release is authorized.

backend_digest.description: Versioned, immutable backend image digest approved for deployment.

frontend_digest.description: Versioned, immutable frontend image digest approved for deployment.

dns_names.description: Approved public DNS names served by Caddy over HTTPS.

approvals.description: Named human go/no-go approvals required before each runtime write.

protected_config_attestation.description: Opaque attestation identifier that the owner-only protected environment source is present. Never a credential.

attested.description: True only when TLS material and DNS/domain control are attested.
True only when capacity limits are attested.

retention_window.description: Diagnostic-retention window in seconds for redacted receipts and logs.

state.description: Publication state of this plan. Traffic is enabled only in 'active'.

receipt_ids.description: Opaque identifiers of the retained redacted receipts this plan depends on.

residual_risk_recorded.description: True only when the same-host administrative residual risk is recorded.

approver.description: Opaque approver identity (role/principal, never a credential).
